## Evergreen publication delivered today

The owner requested a publication with durable SEO/GEO value and information difficult to obtain from a shallow search result. The selected question was:

> Where does native coding-agent telemetry end, and when does independent system-level observation add information that Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, OpenTelemetry, or MCP records do not already contain?

The existing `/blog/system-boundary-observability/` page already owned this reader decision, so the cycle substantially refreshed that canonical URL instead of creating another keyword page.

Primary research used the current Claude Code monitoring/OpenTelemetry reference; Gemini CLI telemetry pinned to `cf22ac7e86f3dcf528e3ae591fec1c03090a49f8`; Codex OpenTelemetry implementation pinned to `3aae5d885bac39c1262491aa3fd100dfd8b3919f`; current OpenTelemetry GenAI and CLI conventions; the MCP tool specification; and AgentSight `v1.0.3` product/OpenTelemetry documentation.

The article's original synthesis is narrower than the old application-vs-system strawman: modern native agent telemetry is already strong for model, tool, policy, session, MCP, and selected file/resource questions. Independent system observation adds its clearest value when execution crosses into descendants, shells, package managers, compilers, MCP servers, containers, plugins, file operations, network destinations, and resource behavior that the parent or child did not instrument. System events alone remain weaker for intent, skill, policy, and tool-selection semantics, so the durable architecture correlates boundaries.

## Long-term content system adopted

PR `#35` records a rolling 48-hour substantive-content SLO in the existing `daily-task.md`, `site.md`, `plan.md`, and `status.md`; no new control or backlog file was created.

- At least one qualifying search-facing publication or major evergreen refresh must be statically published in every rolling 48-hour window.
- A qualifying publication adds durable information through primary-source synthesis, exact implementation/version research, a reproducible AgentSight experiment, real first-party artifacts, measured behavior, or concrete limitations/reference analysis.
- Metadata-only edits, thin release notes, keyword swaps, cosmetic copy changes, generic summaries, and near-duplicate pages do not reset the clock.
- Prefer enriching an existing canonical page whenever it already owns the reader decision.
- If a real external blocker makes the SLO impossible, record the miss instead of publishing filler.
- The scheduler remains a thin external daily pointer; repository instructions are authoritative.
- Daily data work checks source freshness, production/index health, product drift, and the content clock. Full GA4/GSC comparative analysis runs only for new/changed finalized exports or the weekly review.
- Shared SEO skill pin is recorded consistently as `e7338af051ee9621b3033912d5c5751c7ebc241a`.
